title: Expression IX - Long-term survival with gynecological cancer
summary: Based on our experience with the Expression VI survey, that we are already distributing to longterm survivors with ovarian cancer (“Carolin meets HANNA”-Expression VI), we would now like to use a similar questionnaire in longterm survivors with other gynecological cancers (such as endometrial cancer, cervical cancer and rare gynecological cancers such as gynecological sarcoma or granulosa cell tumor). We have modified some questions in the otherwise identical survey. Patients worldwide will be surveyed using an anonymous questionnaire and the Internet. The aim of the survey is to identify potential factors that have a positive impact on disease progression and life expectancy with these tumors.
conditions: rare gynecological cancers such as gynecological sarcoma or granulosa cell tumor

interventions.name: All patients answer the study questionnaire once.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- Eligible are all patients with gynecological cancer with a diagnosis at least more than five years ago.
- A minimum age of 18 years at the timepoint of filling out the survey is assumed.
Exclusion criteria:
Patients under the age of 18 years.
